label.purpose: Form labels, table headers, chips, metadata.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Soft lift on interactive cards/rows on hover only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one emphasized action per view. Registrar Blue fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.875rem; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.62 0.19 264)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.99 0.005 264)); font: 500 0.875rem/1 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.56 0.20 264); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.62 0.19 264 / 0.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions; everything that is not the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.90 0.008 264)); border-radius: 0.875rem; background: var(--background, oklch(0.985 0.004 264)); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.27 0.03 264)); font: 500 0.875rem/1 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, oklch(0.955 0.006 264)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.62 0.19 264 / 0.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Raised surface, flat at rest. One tonal step above the page, full hairline border, no shadow. Never nested.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card, oklch(0.995 0.003 264)); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.27 0.03 264)); border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.90 0.008 264)); border-radius: 22px; padding: 24px; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 6px 20px oklch(0.62 0.19 264 / 0.08); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 0.25rem; font: 600 1.25rem/1.25 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font: 400 0.9375rem/1.55 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.50 0.025 264)); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Labeled field. Hairline border, ring on focus, no glow. Every input carries a programmatic label.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.375rem; } .ds-field-label { font: 500 0.75rem/1.2 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.50 0.025 264)); } .ds-input { height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--input, oklch(0.90 0.01 264)); border-radius: 0.875rem; background: var(--background, oklch(0.985 0.004 264)); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.27 0.03 264)); font: 400 0.9375rem/1.55 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.50 0.025 264)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.62 0.19 264 / 0.5); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.62 0.19 264)); }

components.name: Attendance Badge
components.description: Signature component. Encodes attendance state via status token + text label, never color alone.
components.html: Presente Tarde Ausente
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.125rem 0.625rem; border-radius: 999px; font: 500 0.75rem/1.2 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; } .ds-badge-present { background: oklch(0.62 0.14 150 / 0.14); color: oklch(0.42 0.12 150); } .ds-badge-late { background: oklch(0.76 0.14 75 / 0.18); color: oklch(0.48 0.12 75); } .ds-badge-absent { background: oklch(0.58 0.20 27 / 0.12); color: oklch(0.50 0.19 27); }

narrative.overview: SICAT is a system of record for attendance and coursework, used by coordinators at a desk, teachers taking attendance mid-class on a phone, and students glancing at their record. The interface exists to log a fact and get out of the way. Its character is that of a well-kept institutional ledger: precise, legible, quietly confident. Surfaces are solid and faintly blue-tinted, never frosted. The brand blue is a signal, not a wash: it marks the one primary action, the focus ring, the active nav item, and almost nothing else. This system explicitly rejects glassmorphism as an idiom, multi-radial-gradient backgrounds, hero-metric templates, identical card grids, side-stripe borders, and gradient text.
keyCharacteristics: Solid tinted-neutral surfaces; glass is at most one intentional moment (the login card).
Blue accent on under 10% of any screen.
Flat at rest; elevation is a response to state (hover, focus), not decoration.
Status is semantic: present / absent / late / justified map to success / destructive / warning tokens.
One source of truth: every color is a token defined in frontend/src/index.css.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Registrar Blue appears on at most 10% of any screen. Its rarity is what makes it read as 'the action.' If two blue buttons compete on one screen, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: No #000, no #fff, no pure gray. Every neutral is tinted toward hue 264 (chroma 0.003-0.03). Pure gray is forbidden because it makes the blue look like a mistake rather than a choice.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Geist only. 'Inter' must never be declared again: it was referenced in CSS but never loaded. If you need contrast, change weight or size, not family.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: A surface at rest has no shadow. If you see a shadow without a hover or focus state behind it, delete it.

dos: Do source every color from a semantic token (bg-card, text-foreground, bg-primary, text-destructive).
Do keep Registrar Blue under 10% of any screen.
Do tint every neutral toward hue 264; use OKLCH for new values.
Do map attendance/task states to success / warning / destructive, paired with a text label.
Do use full borders and tonal fills for emphasis.
Do declare Geist as the only font family.
donts: Don't use glassmorphism as a default. Glass is at most one intentional surface (the login card).
Don't paint multi-radial-gradient backgrounds that compete with content.
Don't use #000, #fff, or pure gray. Ever.
Don't use border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't nest a card inside a card, or repeat identical icon-heading-text card grids.
Don't declare 'Inter' again. Geist is the only family.
Don't use alert() / confirm() or ship inputs without an accessible name.
